Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto. Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter towith subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers. In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti's broader mission.WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
- Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
- Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
- Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
- Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
- Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
- Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team's scope.
- Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.WHAT IT TAKES
- Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
- Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.G., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).
- Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
- Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.Be fully aligned to our core values:
- Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.
- Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
- Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
- Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.WHAT WE OFFER
- Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
- Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
- Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone.
- Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
- Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
- An open organisation. Titles don't define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone's work is seen and valued.Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

title: Líder de Hotelaria - Hospital Vera Cruz

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a acreditação da JCI. Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região, com a inauguração de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba. Além disso, realizamos a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care. A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care, que em 2017, ao unir pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, iniciou a trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, com o objetivo de promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos. A atuação da empresa está voltada a cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, em três estados: São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis, com o objetivo de tornar-se a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Seguir as normas de cada setor, instituídas pelos gestores das áreas, a fim de manter o padrão dos processos, cumprindo o Código de Ética Institucional;

title: Product Manager (Senior/Lead) ID42374
description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

MUST HAVES
- 5-7 years working on technology-powered products as either a product manager or user researcher;
- Strong understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends ;
- Proven ability of build intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs;
- Experience in building subscription based products with a track record of driving growth;
- Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction;
- A history of deep and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery;
- Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;
- Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship;
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience;
- Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Deep understanding of gaming trends;
- Strong background in app development and design.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
- A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
- Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

description:
Job description

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

#vemserveracruz #vemparahospitalcare #vemserhospitalcare #vemproveracruz #jeitodeserveracruz

description:
Missão do cargo

Atuar de forma estratégica e consultiva no processo comercial, realizando o acompanhamento de orçamentos, atendimento ativo à carteira de clientes e prospecção de novos negócios, com foco em relacionamento, fidelização e geração de oportunidades. Garantir o registro e acompanhamento das etapas de venda no sistema, desde a elaboração de orçamentos até a entrega do produto, contribuindo para o crescimento sustentável da base de clientes, recuperação de inativos e expansão no mercado corporativo.

Nível de escolaridade

Ensino médio completo

Competências organizacionais

Colaboração, abertura para aprender, orientação para resultado, responsabilidade pessoal, responsabilidades com recursos, relacionamento interpessoal, inovação e pensamento crítico.

Competências para o cargo

Comunicação clara e persuasiva; Proatividade; Foco em resultado; Relacionamento interpessoal; Organização e gestão de tempo; Resiliência e persistência; Escuta ativa; Capacidade analítica; Adaptabilidade; Criatividade e inovação.

Competências técnicas

Necessário experiência em distribuição, vendas corporativas (B2B), gerenciamento de carteira de clientes, captação ativa de clientes, elaboração de propostas comerciais, gerenciamento do processo de venda, vivência e facilidade na utilização de sistemas ERP (cadastro de clientes, geração de orçamentos, propostas, consulta de produtos etc.).

Diferencial experiência com vendas de produtos

TI, segurança eletrônica, informática, materiais elétricos, ferramentas, network (cabeamento estruturado, cabeamento óptico, ativos de redes e acessórios), comunicação unificada (PABX, telefones IP, softwares Call center, Virtualização, Cloud, CRM).

Atividades

  1. Fazer acompanhamento dos orçamentos em aberto no sistema, contatando o cliente por telefone semanalmente, com o objetivo de saber se o cliente está alinhado com as condições apresentadas para fechamento da venda evitando divergências.
  2. Gerenciar a carteira, definindo de forma planejada um grupo de clientes para serem contatados diariamente por telefone ou via web visitas, garantindo a manutenção do relacionamento com os clientes e oportunidades de novos negócios.
  3. Elaborar orçamentos para envio aos clientes por e-mail e/ou WhatsApp, conforme demanda, iniciando assim o processo de venda e registro no sistema interno da necessidade e do interesse dos clientes em relação aos produtos e serviços oferecidos.
  4. Registrar e acompanhar os pedidos de venda, acessando diariamente o sistema interno, garantindo o avanço entre as etapas do processo até a entrega da mercadoria ao cliente.
  5. Recuperar clientes inativos, identificando semanalmente na base de dados cliente que fez apenas uma compra isolada ou que tenha realizado a última compra a mais de 90 dias. Estudar o cliente e definir a estratégia mais adequada de abordagem para recuperá-lo e realizar contato.
  6. Atuar na prospeção de novos clientes do segmento corporativo (B2B), apresentando oportunidades de negócios.
  7. Conhecer e seguir os procedimentos internos relacionados a crédito, expedição, entrega de mercadorias e processos de RMA, garantindo conformidade nas operações.
  8. Analisar tendências de mercado e sugerir ações comerciais, com foco em inovação, atração de novos clientes e aumento do volume de vendas.

QUE TAL TRABALHAR EM UMA EMPRESA A SERVIÇO DAS CIDADES INTELIGENTES DO AMANHÃ?

A INDIGO é líder mundial em gestão de estacionamentos e mobilidade individual. Estamos em mais de 500 cidades de 10 países. No Brasil, são mais de 370 operações em 97 cidades de 24 estados + DF.

Sabe como a gente faz tudo isso acontecer?

Ao redor do mundo, contamos com mais de 9 mil colaboradores – dos quais 4.700 são brasileiros. Todos eles atuam no gerenciamento de soluções personalizadas e cada vez mais inteligentes, que viabilizam uma jornada tranquila e integrada para o cliente.

Uma das prioridades da INDIGO é ouvir seus funcionários e garantir que eles tenham carreiras bem-sucedidas. Por isso, investimos em treinamentos e na criação de políticas de desenvolvimento. Além disso, nos esforçamos para fomentar a igualdade de gênero, promover oportunidades iguais e combater a discriminação. Nosso objetivo é criar um ambiente de trabalho onde todos se sintam realizados, motivados e engajados.

Mais propósito, menos impacto, mais Indigo

Estamos transformando nossos estacionamentos em hubs de serviço úteis e sustentáveis que formam elos cruciais na corrente de mobilidade urbana. Sem estacionamento, não há mobilidade, e, sem mobilidade, não há desenvolvimento. Porém, esse desenvolvimento precisa estar de acordo com o desejo das pessoas: menos estresse, ruídos, poluição e trânsito.

Por isso, “criar espaços para uma cidade tranquila em movimento” é o que fazemos na Indigo. Esse é o nosso propósito. É para isso que trabalhamos diariamente.

The ITOps Analyst will handle all IT operational needs at BotCity (excluding product, engineering, and InfoSec), covering tasks from user provisioning to device management to infrastructure support.   • Support onboarding and off‑boarding processes with IT compliance (access removal, exit checklist).
  • Monitor and manage internal systems (file shares, backup, printers, internal tools) and alert on issues.
  • Create and maintain documentation of IT processes, configurations, user guides, and policies.
  • Assist with small infrastructure projects (office moves, network upgrades, software rollouts).
  • Escalate and coordinate with Engineering and Security teams when needed (e.g., deeper system issues).

Requisitos

  • Technical diploma in Information Systems, Systems Analysis or related degree.
  • Experience (3+ years) in an IT support, systems, or operations role (generalist).
  • Strong experience with user and access management systems (e.g., Google Workspace, SSO, IAM).
  • Experience with service management frameworks / ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk, ServiceNow).
  • Hands‑on experience with Windows / macOS workstations and standard corporate software stacks.
  • Basic knowledge of network fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, TCP/IP) and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with device management (MDM), patching, endpoint security.
  • Experience with inventory / asset management systems.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to work autonomously.
  • Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion, Slack.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team.
  • Portuguese – Fluent.
  • English – Advanced.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to basic scripting / automation (Shell, Python, PowerShell) to automate repetitive IT tasks.
  • Exposure to security best practices (patch management, endpoint protection).
  • Prior experience in an early‑stage, high‑growth, and fast‑paced startup environment or technology companies.

Employment Details

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. We’re looking for a Product Manager to support delivery and execution across our Sales Enablement and Frontline experience teams. In this role, you’ll contribute to initiatives that span multiple tools and workflows used by our sales and customer‑facing teams. You'll work closely with senior PMs, designers, engineers, and go‑to‑market partners to help scope, prioritize, and deliver features that improve productivity, consistency, and experience across our frontline ecosystem.

More about you:

title: Mid-Level Quality Assurance (QA)
description:
Please note that this role works 100% on-site.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

We are looking for a Mid-Level QA professional to work collaboratively within agile teams, participating from the early stages of the development process and actively contributing to the quality of deliveries. We seek someone who understands that quality is not a final phase, but a continuous part of development.

What you'll do:

  • Act as an Agile QA, participating in team ceremonies (refinement, planning, daily, review, and retrospective).
  • Ensure delivery quality from the requirements-gathering phase (shift-left approach).
  • Create, execute, and maintain automated API tests.
  • Support the team in defining clear and testable acceptance criteria.
  • Execute functional, exploratory, and regression tests.
  • Log, track, and manage bugs in a clear, objective, and prioritized manner.
  • Work collaboratively with developers, product, and other stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the team’s quality processes and practices.

What you'll need:

  • Experience with automated API testing (preferably Rest Assured + Kotlin).
  • Knowledge of BDD (Gherkin, Cucumber).
  • Solid understanding of software testing fundamentals.
  • Experience with agile methodologies (Scrum and/or Kanban).
  • Experience in bug management and use of tools such as Jira, Zephyr (or similar).
  • Ability to analyze requirements and identify quality risks.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a team.
  • Proactive, organized, and collaborative profile.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with E2E testing or frontend automation.
  • Basic knowledge of CI/CD and test execution in pipelines.
  • Basic knowledge of non-functional testing (performance, security, etc.).
  • Experience with log analysis and support in troubleshooting.
  • Experience testing in mobile or distributed environments.

More about you:

  • You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

title: Expert Engineer in Verification (UVM/IP/SoC)
description:
Are you willing to participate in the development of a human size growing team?

Aedvices specializes in ICs, FPGAs and embedded systems Front-End Digital Design and Design Verification. We provide flexible solutions to our customers, ranging from turnkey design and verification options to dedicated consulting in design or verification as well as training solutions.

Our customer base spans from large semiconductor groups to small tech startups.

We support a wide range of projects in the automotive, big-data, artificial intelligence and energy sectors, such as the verification of the telemetry system of a Mars probe / Mars tremors or the verification of a System-on-Chip for Bluetooth Low Energy.

To sustain our growth, we are looking for several experienced verification engineers to join the team.

Your main responsibilities

As a key member of the verification team, you will define the verification methodologies and adapt them to the project requirements. You will be responsible for the verification of complex IPs and System-On-Chips, the development of verification environments (SystemVerilog/UVM/other), UVM verification IPs (VIPs), and the writing of verification plans.

You propose improvements to existing flows. You will also have the opportunity to work with colleagues in France and with our partners on innovative approaches and methodologies (formal methods, PSS).

Is the job right for you?

To carry out your missions, you need to master several essential technical topics:

  • Functional verification at IP level and of complex SoC,
  • SystemVerilog testbench and UVM core development,
  • Development of verification plans,
  • AMBA protocols,
  • Embedded software development (C, C++),
  • Knowledge of RTL design languages: VHDL, Verilog,
  • Written and spoken English.

Other skills welcome:

  • Object Oriented Programming,
  • Advanced protocols such as PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, Bluetooth, …
  • ASIC and FPGA design,
  • Scripting (Python).

For an efficient and fruitful collaboration, we expect you to:

  • Have an engineering background or equivalent, and at least 5 years’ experience in verification,
  • Be able to balance perfectionism and pragmatism!
  • Be eager to learn new things, grow your skills and elaborate creative technical solutions,
  • Be able to work in a team,
  • Think “problem solving” and think “out of the box”,
  • And last but not least: be committed to customers’ satisfaction.

What we offer you

  • Continue to develop your expertise with the access of all our training materials,
  • Join a friendly company who share values of Diversity, Conviviality, Technical Expertise and Passion,
  • Benefit from a flexible organization with the possibility of remote work,
  • Full time contract,
  • Additional benefits such as meal voucher and dental health.

Want to join us?

Our recruitment process is simple:

After an initial call, you’ll meet with Agnès, our HR Manager, and Eric, our Verification Technical Director.

If your expectations match ours, the recruitment process concludes with a meeting with Fabio, our Brazil director.

description:
Enfermeiro (a) JR - Hemodinâmica / Hospital Vera Cruz

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi‑intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on‑demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and tabletop beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

We are looking for a Mid‑Level QA professional to work collaboratively within agile teams, participating from the early stages of the development process and actively contributing to the quality of deliveries. We seek someone who understands that quality is not a final phase, but a continuous part of development.

What you’ll do:

  • Act as an Agile QA, participating in team ceremonies (refinement, planning, daily, review, and retrospective).
  • Ensure delivery quality from the requirements‑gathering phase (shift‑left approach).
  • Create, execute, and maintain automated API tests.
  • Support the team in defining clear and testable acceptance criteria.
  • Execute functional, exploratory, and regression tests.
  • Log, track, and manage bugs in a clear, objective, and prioritized manner.
  • Work collaboratively with developers, product, and other stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the team’s quality processes and practices.

What you’ll need:

  • Experience with automated API testing (preferably Rest Assured + Kotlin).
  • Knowledge of BDD (Gherkin, Cucumber).
  • Solid understanding of software testing fundamentals.
  • Experience with agile methodologies (Scrum and/or Kanban).
  • Experience in bug management and use of tools such as Jira, Zephyr (or similar).
  • Ability to analyze requirements and identify quality risks.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a team.
  • Proactive, organized, and collaborative profile.

Nice to Have

  • Advanced communication skills in English (written and spoken).
  • Experience with E2E testing or frontend automation.
  • Basic knowledge of CI/CD and test execution in pipelines.
  • Basic knowledge of non‑functional testing (performance, security, etc.).
  • Experience with log analysis and support in troubleshooting.
  • Experience testing in mobile or distributed environments.

More about you:

  • Você´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • Você´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • Você´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

  • Attendance Bonus*

For more information visit

The Client Onboarding Department is responsible for conducting the process of identifying and verifying new customers. The team plays a key role in combatting financial crime and terrorist financing.

Role Summary

To ensure that customers across business divisions are on‑boarded efficiently and in accordance with Group policies and procedures.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure that appropriate CDD / KYC and AML checks are carried out on all new customers in accordance with local regulatory requirements and Group standards and procedures
  • Ensure that appropriate client documentation is issued to all new customers and in accordance with local regulatory and any exchange requirements
  • Ensure that appropriate customer categorisations are carried out in accordance with local regulatory requirements
  • Ensure daily targets set by the Onboarding Manager are met
  • Accurately update the customer pipeline on a daily basis (Neon Onboarding)
  • Ensure that client and static data is accurately input and maintained into the Client Data Base (PeopleSoft)
  • Ensure that complete records of all customer documentation are maintained
  • Ensure that the Front‑Office, Co‑Ordination Team and Quality Control Teams are advised of case progress
  • Issue client acceptance documentation and conduct account opening
  • Assist on any other ad‑hoc reviews/projects/audits that the Onboarding department is required to carry out
  • Efficiently dealing with general day‑to‑day ad‑hoc queries
  • Work closely with the Financial Crime team
  • Keeping management timely informed of issues/developments
  • Ensuring compliance with the company’s regulatory requirements
  • Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with.
  • Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integrity and conduct and reflecting Company Values.
  • At all times complying with Marex’s Code of Conduct
  • To ensure that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility
  • To report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/ or your supervisor as required
  • To escalate risk events immediately
  • To provide input to risk management processes, as required.

Skills and Experience

  • Experience in client onboarding, KYC and risk assessment of clients

  • Analytical skills
  • Problem solving skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Competencies

Conduct Rules

You must:

  • Act with integrity

Company Values

Acting as a role model for the values of the Company:

Respect - Clients are at the heart of our business, with superior execution and superb client service the foundation of the firm. We respect our clients and always treat them fairly.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar conosco como Representante de Serviços em Campo II e fazer parte de nossa equipe.

A Ecolab acredita na inclusão e na promoção da diversidade em todas as suas formas. Temos como valor e premissa, o respeito e valorização das pessoas e combatemos qualquer tipo de discriminação. Ao fazer parte do nosso time, você poderá participar ativamente da construção da Diversidade, Equidade & Inclusão na companhia e ser um aliado dos nossos Grupos de Afinidade, como o E3 (focado no desenvolvimento de mulheres), o Ecoessence (focado no desenvolvimento de pessoas negras), e do Pride (LGBTQIAP+).

  • Atuar com serviços técnicos nos equipamentos de tratamentos químicos nas instalações dos clientes assegurando a eficiência e funcionalidade deles;
  • Auxiliar as operações dos clientes e garantir que estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança, de modo a mensurar o resultado ao programa de soluções;
  • Realizar o controle de dosagem química nos produtos utilizados nas instalações dos clientes para assegurar que estejam dentro das variações estabelecidas;
  • Coletar amostras e realizar as análises físico-químicas reportando os resultados ao laboratório central e ao cliente;
  • Controlar estoque de produtos nas instalações do cliente para um fornecimento dentro do prazo acordado;
  • Detectar e reportar falhas e/ou problemas com produtos quando estiverem fora das variações estabelecidas, oferecendo alternativas rentáveis, conforme necessário;
  • Participar de reuniões com a equipe para promover melhorias em atendimento ao cliente;
  • Reportar serviços concluídos, fornecendo clareza e valor ao cliente;
  • Atendimento de serviços realizados via plataformas digitais e fechamentos das atividades são por ordem de serviços.

Quais são os requisitos para poder participar deste Processo Seletivo?

  • Formados no curso Técnico ou Superior em Química, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas (que possuam autorização para o profissional ter o CRQ);
  • Possuir certificação CRQ (apto ou com disponibilidade para ativar);
  • Profissionais com conhecimento em tratamento de águas de industriais em gerais;
  • Possui CNH B (para dirigir carro da empresa) com no mínimo 2 anos de emissão e que esteja ATIVA. (não podendo encontrar-se suspensa, recolhida ou qualquer outra condição que impossibilidade o Funcionário de utilizar veículo)
  • Você precisará ter disponibilidade para nas regiões de Campinas, Valinhos, Vinhedo, Jundiaí/SP ;
  • Flexibilidade de horário para viagens e para possíveis demandas pontuais;

O que fará seu perfil se destacar dos demais?

  • Ter experiência profissional em indústria de tratamento de águas;
  • Experiência no setor de químicos;
  • Conhecimentos em Pacote Office (Excel, Power Point e Outlook) e sistemas;
  • Habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento.

O que te oferecemos nessa jornada?

Salário competitivo, Auxílio Refeição, Carro Ferramenta, Convênio Médico e Odontológico, Gympass, Seguro de Vida, Previdência Privada, PLR, Programa de Treinamentos Internos, Programa de Desenvolvimento e Trilha de Carreira, entre outros

Um parceiro de confiança para quase três milhões de clientes, a Ecolab é líder global em sustentabilidade, oferecendo soluções e serviços para água, higiene e prevenção de infecções, que protegem as pessoas e os recursos vitais. Com mais de um século de inovação, a Ecolab apresenta vendas anuais de US$ 14 bilhões e 47.000 funcionários, operando em mais de 170 países em todo o mundo. A empresa oferece soluções abrangentes, baseadas na ciência, conhecimentos específicos e serviços de classe mundial para promover a segurança dos alimentos, manter os ambientes limpos e seguros e otimizar o uso da água e energia. As soluções inovadoras da Ecolab melhoram a eficiência operacional e a sustentabilidade de clientes nos setores de alimentos, industrial, saúde e hospitalidade.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on‑demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and tabletop beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

As a Product Manager for Seller Tools, you will drive the evolution of our ecosystem of tools, ensuring it is both user‑centric and technically sound. You’ll blend strong product expertise (discovery, prioritization, roadmap, UX focus) with technical depth (services, APIs, architecture, data) to deliver scalable, high‑performing solutions.

You’ll act as the connector between commercial operations, end‑users, and engineering, shaping tools that improve partner autonomy, streamline workflows, optimize execution, and unlock new opportunities through data and AI.

What you’ll do:

  • Ownership of end to end Seller Tools, from discovery to execution to adoption;
  • Lead discovery processes to identify user pain points, market gaps, and opportunities for improving workflows;
  • Define product roadmaps that align with business objectives and technical architecture;
  • Collaborate deeply with engineering and architecture teams, understanding APIs, data flows, and service dependencies to make informed product decisions;
  • Balance short‑term feature delivery with long‑term scalability and system health;
  • Translate operational and market needs into clear, technically feasible requirements;
  • Partner with Design to ensure intuitive, operator‑friendly experiences;
  • Define success metrics for features, monitor adoption, and iterate based on data insights;
  • Leverage data to drive prioritization, experimentation, and continuous improvement;
  • Lead efforts to design, integrate, and scale AI‑driven solutions across the product ecosystem;
  • Act as the voice of the customer and operator, while ensuring alignment with system capabilities and architectural vision.

What you’ll need:

  • University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related area (or equivalent experience);
  • Years of product management experience in enterprise tools, SaaS, or related domains;
  • Strong product expertise in discovery, prioritization, roadmap definition, and UX improvements;
  • Data‑centric mindset, with experience using analytics tools (e.g., Segment, Mixpanel, Databricks, Looker, Tableau, or similar) to drive decisions;
  • Technical knowledge of APIs, microservices, cloud‑based tools, and system integrations (able to discuss trade‑offs with engineers);
  • Experience working with both frontend and backend development teams;
  • Demonstrated experience designing or integrating AI/ML features into existing products;
  • Proficiency with product management tools such as Jira and Confluence;
  • Strong understanding of Scrum and agile workflows;
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both technical and business‑focused.

More about you:

  • You’re passionate about software development and know how to ensure its quality;
  • You’re motivated by building world‑class solutions that impact millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment that uses and stimulates a DevOps culture;
  • You’re creative when solving problems and are continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;

  • You have the autonomy to recognize current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

title: Mid-Level Quality Assurance (QA)
description:
Please note that this role works 100% on-site.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

We are looking for a Mid-Level QA professional to work collaboratively within agile teams, participating from the early stages of the development process and actively contributing to the quality of deliveries. We seek someone who understands that quality is not a final phase, but a continuous part of development.

What you'll do:

  • Act as an Agile QA, participating in team ceremonies (refinement, planning, daily, review, and retrospective).
  • Ensure delivery quality from the requirements-gathering phase (shift-left approach).
  • Create, execute, and maintain automated API tests.
  • Support the team in defining clear and testable acceptance criteria.
  • Execute functional, exploratory, and regression tests.
  • Log, track, and manage bugs in a clear, objective, and prioritized manner.
  • Work collaboratively with developers, product, and other stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the team’s quality processes and practices.

What you'll need:

  • Experience with automated API testing (preferably Rest Assured + Kotlin).
  • Knowledge of BDD (Gherkin, Cucumber).
  • Solid understanding of software testing fundamentals.
  • Experience with agile methodologies (Scrum and/or Kanban).
  • Experience in bug management and use of tools such as Jira, Zephyr (or similar).
  • Ability to analyze requirements and identify quality risks.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a team.
  • Proactive, organized, and collaborative profile.

Nice to Have

  • Advanced communication skills in English (written and spoken);
  • Experience with E2E testing or frontend automation.
  • Basic knowledge of CI/CD and test execution in pipelines.
  • Basic knowledge of non-functional testing (performance, security, etc.).
  • Experience with log analysis and support in troubleshooting.
  • Experience testing in mobile or distributed environments.

Descrição da vaga

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Na XP Inc., acreditamos que nosso time é a chave para o sucesso. Procuramos profissionais em início de carreira, apaixonados pelo mercado financeiro, que compartilhem nossos valores: foco no cliente, espírito empreendedor, mente aberta e sonho grande.

Aqui, você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de comunicação, aprofundamento nos produtos de financeiros e principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro.   • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina para contato online com clientes;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades;

Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Junte-se ao nosso Banco de Talentos exclusivo para profissionais do Segmento Contábil , do nível Júnior à Gerente .

Ao fazer parte deste seleto grupo, seu currículo ficará disponível para futuras oportunidades que se alinhem às suas habilidades e experiências. Não perca a chance de ser considerado para posições que podem surgir em breve!

Na área de Impostos para Serviços Financeiros, oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia – e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios.

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Você fará parte da área de Impostos, atuando em projetos de outsourcing contábil para grandes clientes do setor financeiro, como bancos e seguradoras. Essa é uma excelente oportunidade para atuar com execução e análise contábil, apoiar ou liderar processos técnicos, e contribuir com a excelência nas entregas aos clientes.

O Banco de Talentos é direcionado para profissionais com experiência e conhecimento em:

  • Conciliações e aplicação de normas contábeis, especialmente no setor financeiro;
  • Atuação consistente com BACEN, gestão de fundos e conhecimento de órgãos reguladores como CVM e SUSEP;
  • Conhecimento prático no sistema Protheus (TOTVS), Oracle, Fusion ou Netsuíte serão também considerados como diferenciais;
  • Perfil técnico voltado à contabilidade regulatória e compliance financeiro;
  • Formação em Contabilidade com CRC ativo;
  • Inglês intermediário.

Localidade: nível Brasil, em um de nossos escritórios: Belo Horizonte, Blumenau, Brasília, Campinas, Curitiba, Fortaleza, Goiânia, Porto Alegre, Recife, Ribeirão Preto, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador e São Paulo.

O que oferecemos: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Acesse go.ey.com/benefícios e conheça nosso universo de benefícios.

Quem somos Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas como o Programa de Treinees exclusivo para PcD. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.

Segundo o Great Place to Work 2023, somos a melhor empresa para Pessoas Pretas e Mulheres do Brasil e a 2ª melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor!

title: Enfermeiro (a) JR - UTI Adulto / Hospital Vera Cruz
description:
Descrição da vaga

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

#vemserveracruz #vemparahospitalcare #vemserhospitalcare #vemproveracruz #jeitodeserveracruz

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar, executar e acompanhar a assistência de enfermagem
  • Participar das visitas multidisciplinares das unidades com foco nas ações do plano terapêutico do dia;
  • Prestar assistência com qualidade e segurança de acordo com a complexidade e perfil de atendimento;
  • Realizar treinamentos/acompanhamentos dos liderados;
  • Realizar feedback dos colaboradores;
  • Realizar interface/integração com a equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Realizar planejamento da unidade com a gestão da agenda cirúrgica do dia e previsões de alta;
  • Acompanhar e monitorar as ações dos auxiliares de escritórios e auxiliares administrativos;
  • Realizar Interface/Integração com diversos departamentos para melhor funcionalidade do setor;
  • Acompanhar e monitorar a Adesão ADEP/Palm;
  • Realizar e acompanhar a passagem de plantão; devolução de material e medicamento e solicitações de OPME;
  • Acompanhar a Auditorias da Unidade: VISA, CCIH; Auditoria de Acreditações, Fiscalização COREN, entre outros;
  • Solucionar ouvidorias e conflitos do plantão;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de POP’s, Rotinas e PMI das Unidades;
  • Garantir o registro adequado do cuidado no Prontuário Eletrônico;
  • Garantir a aplicação das 6 metas Internacionais de Segurança;
  • Realizar SAE e prescrever plano de cuidados;
  • Aplicar escalas de complexidade de acordo com o perfil e avaliação dos riscos assistenciais;
  • Demais atividades pertinentes ao Enfermeiro.

  • Graduação completa em Enfermagem;

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

We are hiring a Data Product Manager – FinOps to plan and execute on FinOps initiatives, partnering closely with Finance, Engineering and Commercial. This role focuses on stakeholder analysis, requirements definition, feature delivery, and dashboard execution for FinOps tools and reporting.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with cloud cost data, metrics, and dashboards, and is comfortable translating business and operational needs into clear, actionable product requirements.

What you'll do:

  • Partner with Finance, Accounting, Engineering, and Cloud Operations to understand cost drivers and reporting needs.

  • Define KPI logic, calculations, and metric definitions in collaboration with stakeholders.

Product Execution

  • Write clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Support backlog management, sprint planning, and delivery tracking.

Metrics, Data Quality & Governance

  • Ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of financial and cloud cost data.
  • Reconcile metrics with Finance and Accounting stakeholders as needed.
  • Identify data quality gaps and work with engineering to resolve them.

What you'll need:

  • Years of experience in Cloud Operations, FinOps, Data Analytics, Business Analysis, or related roles.
  • Hands-on experience working with cloud cost and usage data (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Strong proficiency in Power BI, including data modeling and DAX.
  • Experience defining and working with metrics, KPIs, and dashboards.
  • Experience gathering requirements and working with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills ( English and Portuguese ).

Convocar reuniões periódicas com os envolvidos nos processos, acompanhando a execução dos serviços, geral e por canteiro, coordenando, mentalizando e motivando as equipes, objetivando a busca da otimização dos indicadores de desempenho, qualidade e das margens de contribuição.

Proceder a identificação e resolução de problemas, surgidos dentro da sua área de competência, aplicando seus conhecimentos teóricos e práticos, visando assegurar o desenvolvimento normal dos trabalhos.

Acompanhar, treinar e fornecer feedback a sua equipe de trabalho, estimulando-os e/ou incentivando-os, a fim de obter alta performance pessoal/profissional e melhorar o nível de satisfação pessoal, bem como uma maior integração e compatibilização das ações com a realidade da Empresa.

Participar de treinamentos e seminários que propiciem o aprimoramento e o aperfeiçoamento do conhecimento no próprio setor de atuação ou cargo exercido, objetivando a melhoria contínua, bem como o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
About the job: Quality Assurance Engineer

Quality Assurance Engineer (QA) with TypeScript and Node.js

Position Overview

As a Quality Assurance Engineer at The Methodical Group, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and usability of our applications built on TypeScript and Node.js foundations. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and designers, to deliver high-quality software solutions that meet our clients' needs and exceed their expectations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Test Planning and Strategy: Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies based on project requirements and specifications. Identify testing objectives, scope, and priorities to ensure thorough test coverage.
  • Test Execution: Execute manual and automated tests to verify the functionality, performance, and security of web applications built on TypeScript and Node.js. Conduct regression testing, smoke testing, and exploratory testing as needed.
  • Defect Management: Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects using issue tracking systems. Collaborate with development teams to investigate and resolve issues in a timely manner.
  • Automation Testing: Develop and maintain automated test scripts using testing frameworks and libraries specific to TypeScript and Node.js. Continuously enhance test automation frameworks to improve efficiency and reliability.
  • Quality Assurance Processes: Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance QA processes, tools, and methodologies. Contribute to the development and adoption of best practices for software quality assurance.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with software developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements, provide feedback on design and functionality, and ensure alignment with quality standards.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain test documentation, including test plans, test cases, test reports, and other relevant artifacts. Ensure that documentation is accurate, up-to-date, and accessible to team members.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proven experience in quality assurance/testing of web applications, preferably using TypeScript and Node.js technologies.
  • Solid understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Proficiency in test automation using testing frameworks/tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) is a plus.
  • Knowledge of continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and tools is desirable.

Na CPFL, você encontra um ambiente sólido para crescer com confiança, com segurança para evoluir e espaço para construir um futuro com propósito.

  • Experiência sólida com SAP MM (Materials Management), especialmente com projeto de implantação SAP S/4HANA no setor de energia.

  • Conhecimento em debug para funcionais.

O seu dia a dia:

  • Trabalhar com SAP MM (Materials Management), preferencialmente em ambiente SAP S/4HANA.
  • Aplicar profundo conhecimento nos processos de gestão de materiais: compras, inventário, gestão de estoques, MRP, configuração de tipos de materiais, grupos de compras, centros de custo e políticas de inventário.

  • Gerenciar processos de procurement: requisições, pedidos de compra, contratos e fontes de fornecimento.
  • Atuar com foco em conformidade regulatória do setor elétrico, assegurando conformidade do SAP S/4HANA MM com as normativas vigentes.
  • Atuar em projetos de implementação, sustentação ou melhorias dos processos de negócios do setor elétrico com SAP S/4HANA.
  • Atuar como integrador entre áreas de negócio, TI e fornecedores, colaborando com stakeholders e alta gestão.

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.
